text:
elaine: Kicking off Partner Hub readiness thread — focus: marketplace listing, joint GTM (press/blog/landing), hardware partner onboarding, SI dry-run. Need owners + dates.

matt: Can we lock an embargo window? Suggest May 10-12 for embargo -> launch on May 12. Press deck & blog drafts needed by May 3.

nisha: Confirmed. SI dry-run target May 5. Need test tenant credentials from partners (CloudStore, EdgeWorks) by Apr 28.

sam: From infra side: feature-flag + canary path ready. We need a fallback model variant to avoid perf regressions. Who owns rollback keys?

carlos: Partner ops: shipping of EdgeWorks RSV hardware samples in progress — ETA Apr 25. Will provide serials for validation once received.

ana: Legal: partner quotes need sign-off and brief embargo NDAs. Please route quotes to me by Apr 29.

deploy-bot: Scheduled storefront deploy window: May 11 02:00-04:00 UTC (canary), May 12 09:00-12:00 UTC (full). See CI run: https://ci.redwood.ai/flows/partner-launch

matt: Suggest 45-min partner preview calls on May 4 @10am PT — invite partners + press lead. @elaine can you coordinate calendar invites?

elaine: On it. I'll draft invites & agenda. Draft agenda: 1) launch timeline 2) partner integration status 3) press assets & quotes 4) Q&A.

nisha: Posting quick timeline snippet:
```
Apr 22 - Finalize landing copy
Apr 28 - Partner test creds due
May 3  - Press + blog drafts done
May 4  - Partner preview calls
May 5  - SI dry-run
May 10 - Embargo window begins
May 11 - Canary deploy
May 12 - Public launch
```

sam: FYI we'll expose a debug flag for SI dry-run: ?partner_dryrun=1 — keep it scoped to partner IPs only.

carlos: I'll follow up on serials + QA checklist. Also need a short validation script for partners to run. @sam can you share a small curl test we can ship?

sam: Sure. Example test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/verify -H "Authorization: Bearer PARTNER_TOKEN" -d '{"ping":"hi"}'
```

matt: Marketing + comms: draft blog owner @matt, PR owner @elaine, landing owner @nisha. Please update doc: https://docs.google.com/partner-hub-launch (edit access granted)

ana: Reminder: no partner quotes in PR before signed release forms. Use placeholder '[Partner]' until cleared.

elaine: Owners assigned. I'll compile a single checklist and ping owners daily. Quick asks:
- @carlos confirm hardware serials by Apr 25
- @nisha confirm landing copy freeze Apr 22
- @matt confirm blog draft by May 3
- @sam provide curl test by Apr 26

matt: Confirmed. I'll lock blog draft owner and schedule review with product comms.

carlos: Confirming serials ETA Apr 24-25. Will attach shipping receipts here when done.

nisha: Copy freeze noted. Will push edits to the shared doc and tag reviewers.

elaine: Perfect. Closing with one more ask — can legal provide embargo wording sample? @ana

ana: Sending sample now, file attached to the doc. Use section "Embargo Terms v1" and iterate.

matt: :thumbsup: if everyone good, I'll start partner preview invites at EOD.

elaine: :thumbsup: thanks team — will follow up with consolidated checklist by noon tomorrow.
